candidate_workaround: Resolve manifest entries from their immutable commit object rather than hashing later working-tree files.
failure_signature: A historical manifest test compares commit-local blobs to mutable successor working-tree bytes.
recurrence_guard: Bind every historical manifest assertion to its declared immutable Git commit.
rollback: Retain the failed development run and award no manifest credit until commit-local comparison passes.
title: Bind historical manifests to immutable Git objects
trigger_preconditions: Later lifecycle work legitimately edits paths that were present in an earlier manifest.
